subject.title: feat(control-ui): add cron calendar timeline view

question: Should maintainers sponsor a rebase/adoption of this cron timeline branch, request a fresh narrower PR against the current Cron page, or defer the feature to the canonical issue backlog?
rationale: The feature is useful and has visual proof, but the branch is stale, conflicting, and needs product ownership plus non-trivial contract-preserving rework rather than a small automated repair.

options.title: Request Fresh/Rebased PR
options.body: Keep the feature issue open and ask for a new or heavily rebased branch against `ui/src/pages/cron/view.ts` that preserves current cron contracts.

options.title: Adopt And Repair
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly sponsor this branch and own the rebase, scheduler/status correctness, and i18n regeneration work.

options.title: Defer Feature
options.body: Leave the canonical issue as backlog and stop treating this stale branch as the landing path for now.

recommendation.title: Request Fresh/Rebased PR
recommendation.body: Keep the feature issue open and ask for a new or heavily rebased branch against `ui/src/pages/cron/view.ts` that preserves current cron contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent current-main ownership signal on the Cron page view surface where a rebase would land.
